The PDF was reached anonymously from the publisher's article page through its download link. Candidate: this as the reference the CFD's centreline velocity against time is compared with. Critique: the series is quoted from Waters and King (1970), Rheol. Acta 9, 345, which this seat could not read (no open copy found); the OpenFOAM-9 program (mat-20261121-openfoam-9-planarpoiseuille-watersking) states the same terms, and the Basilisk test (mat-20261121-basilisk-poiseuille-oldroydb) an equivalent form whose text and code differ. Refinement: the reference is this paper's equations (2.6)-(2.9), the original noted as not read. The paper's figures and error norms (section 4) are numerical results of the same flow and may serve the tolerance as a material of the same system.
